To find the characteristic polynomial of the matrix $A = \begin{pmatrix} -4 & -13 & 10 \\ -9 & 10 & 4 \\ 12 & -5 & -14 \end{pmatrix}$, we need to compute $\det(\lambda I - A) = 0$.

The matrix $\lambda I - A$ is:
$$
\lambda I - A = \begin{pmatrix} 
\lambda + 4 & 13 & -10 \\ 
9 & \lambda - 10 & -4 \\ 
-12 & 5 & \lambda + 14 
\end{pmatrix}
$$

We calculate the determinant by expanding along the first row:
$$
\begin{aligned}
\det(\lambda I - A) &= (\lambda + 4) \det \begin{pmatrix} \lambda - 10 & -4 \\ 5 & \lambda + 14 \end{pmatrix} - 13 \det \begin{pmatrix} 9 & -4 \\ -12 & \lambda + 14 \end{pmatrix} - 10 \det \begin{pmatrix} 9 & \lambda - 10 \\ -12 & 5 \end{pmatrix} \\
&= (\lambda + 4) [(\lambda - 10)(\lambda + 14) - (-4)(5)] - 13 [9(\lambda + 14) - (-4)(-12)] - 10 [9(5) - (\lambda - 10)(-12)] \\
&= (\lambda + 4) (\lambda^2 + 4\lambda - 120) - 13 (9\lambda + 78) - 10 (225 - 12\lambda) \\
&= (\lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 - 104\lambda - 480) - (117\lambda + 1014) + (120\lambda - 2250) \\
&= \lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 - 104\lambda - 480 - 117\lambda - 1014 + 120\lambda - 2250 \\
&= \lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 - 101\lambda - 3744
\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, the characteristic polynomial of the matrix is $\lambda^3 + 8\lambda^2 - 101\lambda - 3744$.
